The Ares Management offices in Los Angeles.

Only for a long-running Ares Management Corp. private credit fund would the acquisition of a former rival — and its portfolio of more than 200 companies — be considered “additive, rather than transformative.”

That’s because the $29 billion Ares Capital Corp. has swallowed up even larger competitors since it was founded over two decades ago, turning it into far and away the largest publicly traded business development company, now almost twice the size of its next biggest rival.
